# Harry Bone Drum Lessons

> Drum lessons in Brislington, Bristol, UK with Harry Bone: BMus (Hons) from the Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama, 20+ years playing, teaching since 2018, Enhanced DBS checked. Lessons at Harry's home studio in Brislington or at the student's home anywhere in Bristol (no travel fee). Ages 7 and up, complete beginners to advanced, including Rockschool grade preparation. Trial lesson £10 for 30 minutes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com): who Harry is, what lessons are like, reviews, prices, how to book.
- [Lessons & Pricing](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com/lessons): prices, how lessons work, studio or home, what lessons cover, teaching resources.
- [About](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com/about): training (RWCMD, Latin percussion in Cuba, samba in Rio), teaching background, videos of Harry's playing.
- [Reviews](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com/reviews): what students and parents say.
- [Book a trial](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com/contact): the booking form for a £10 trial lesson.

## Prices

- Trial: 30 min, £10
- Standard: 30 min, £20
- Extended: 45 min, £30
- Full: 1 hour, £40
- Parent and child, shared: 1 hour, £35
- No sign-up fees, no contracts. Lessons roll on, usually 4 a month.

## Booking and contact

- Book a trial: https://harrybonedrumlessons.com/contact
- Email: harrybonedrumlessons@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +44 7984 263112
- Location: Brislington, Bristol. Directions are sent when a lesson is booked.

## Related

- [Partner](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6753584431): Harry's practice app for students aged 13 and over, on the iOS App Store. It remembers each practice session and plans the next one around it.
- [Harry's drumming on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnW7DBoH5op8JxS3NwyhbSF51bxWpDvY5): Rockschool Grade 3 to Grade 8, plus double kick.
